title: RAID HUD CORNERS GO QUIET
why: UI step 3 of the HUD calm job (102). The critic: the corners compete with the ammo hero. The item count and the backpack cue on the gun card were 20 and 24 px on screen and are 16 now (the style guide label size). The pillager board title was amber while the run info title is cream; it is cream now, so amber stays for focus and warnings. The hidden chip was 22 px amber on a 78 percent plate; it is label size on the same 88 percent plate as the rest. Nothing moves.
now: The item count and backpack hint on the ammo card are smaller. The pillager board title is cream. The hidden chip is smaller.
